title: Malliavin calculus and the Clark–Ocone representation
abstract: Constructs the Malliavin derivative, Gaussian integration by parts, closability, Wiener chaos, Brownian Itô integration and martingale representation. The Clark–Ocone endpoint uses a generating pre-Brownian process with continuous linear coordinates on a separable real Gaussian Banach space, its natural filtration, and pairs in the closed Malliavin graph; the conditional-expectation sections agree almost everywhere at positive times.

informal.PalomarClarkOcone.generated_clark_ocone: For a generating pre-Brownian process on a separable real Gaussian Banach space whose coordinates are pointwise represented by continuous linear functionals, constructs a time realization of the Malliavin derivative and an Itô isometry for the natural filtration, with martingale representation for every terminal L² variable. For pairs in the closed Malliavin graph, the Clark–Ocone formula identifies the derivative's predictable projection with its conditional-expectation sections for almost every positive time.
